question: How will {name} sign in?

option.username: Through a child account with a username
option.email: Through a child account with the child’s email address

optionHint.parent: The parent signs in on the device and hands it to the child. The child has no username or password of their own.
optionHint.username: The parent sets up the username and password for the child.
optionHint.email: The parent creates the account; the child confirms their email address and creates their own password.

parentModeNote: Nothing to fill in — {name} will sign in when you switch to them from your own account.
usernameHint: Letters and numbers only, 3 to 20 characters.
usernameInvalid: Use 3 to 20 letters or numbers, with no spaces.
usernameTaken: That username is taken. Try another one.
passwordHint: At least {count} characters. Read it out to your gamer — you can change it here later.
passwordTooShort: The password needs at least {count} characters.
emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address.
emailTaken: That email address already has an account.
